notes:
Drawing is tilted ~8 deg. Five identical inverting op-amp cells (11, 17, 20, 22, 23). Every op-amp triangle is drawn with its flat INPUT edge running up-right across the top and its output apex at the bottom-right vertex: the + mark sits under the LEFT end of that top edge and the - mark under the RIGHT end, so index 0 (in+) is the left vertex, index 1 (in-) is the right end of the top edge and index 2 (out) is the bottom-right vertex (verified at 8-12x on op-amps 11, 17, 20, 22, 23). Each cell has a rectangular feedback loop drawn to the right of the triangle: out -> down/right -> up the right side through the feedback element -> back left into the in- node. Cell inventory: op-amp 20 with inductor 7 (1uH) feedback and I-DC 6 (10A) as input; op-amp 17 with capacitor 8 (3uF) feedback and V-DC 9 as input; op-amp 22 with inductor 5 feedback and resistor 1 (1k) as input; op-amp 11 with capacitor 12 (2uF) feedback and resistor 2 (1k) as input; op-amp 23 with inductor 3 feedback and capacitor 21 (3uF) as input.
Net map: 0 = the common reference - all six GND symbols (13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19) plus everything they touch: the left terminal of I-DC 6 (GND 16), the left terminal of V-DC 9 (GND 13), and the in+ pins of op-amps 20 (GND 15), 17 (GND 18), 11 (GND 14) and 23 (GND 19). n1 = in- node of op-amp 20 at (156,124): right terminal of I-DC 6 and the top of inductor 7. n2 = output of op-amp 20 at (167,186) -> (177,203) -> (231,189): bottom of inductor 7 and the top lead of resistor 2, which then runs down through (241,212) to (250,234). n3 = in- node of op-amp 17 at (358,58): right terminal of V-DC 9 and the top plate of capacitor 8. n4 = output of op-amp 17 at (372,120) -> (382,139): bottom plate of capacitor 8 and the top of resistor 1. n5 = in- node of op-amp 22 at (414,231): top of inductor 5 and the bottom of resistor 1. n6 = output of op-amp 22 at (433,303) -> (443,324): bottom of inductor 5 and the top of resistor 0. n7 = in- node of op-amp 11 at (285,317): bottom of resistor 2 and the top plate of capacitor 12. n8 = output of op-amp 11 at (298,388) -> (305,401): bottom plate of capacitor 12 and the top of resistor 10. n9 = in- node of op-amp 23 at (131,329): bottom plate of capacitor 21 and the top of inductor 3. n10 = output of op-amp 23 at (137,412) -> (147,431): bottom of inductor 3 and the top of resistor 4. n11 = the long bottom wire running (173,506) -> (330,465) -> (478,426): bottom ends of resistors 4, 10 and 0 (resistor 10 lands on it as a T at (330,465), the other two are corners). n12 = the long shallow wire from (103,244) up-right to (314,197): the top plate of capacitor 21 at its left corner and, after the corner at (314,197) and the dog-leg (344,250)-(375,240), the in+ pin of op-amp 22 at (380,262). This is the only op-amp + input in the drawing that is not grounded, which is consistent with there being 6 GND symbols for 5 op-amps + 2 sources.
Judgment calls: (a) the wire carrying n2 down from op-amp 20's output to resistor 2 CROSSES the n12 wire at (241,212). Pixel-level inspection at 16x shows a plain X - two 1-2 px strokes passing through each other with no junction dot and no hop, and it is the only crossing in the whole drawing (every other meeting is a drawn corner or T). It is therefore read as a crossover, keeping n2 and n12 separate. Merging them would be the single change with the biggest effect on this netlist, so it is the thing to re-check. (b) Resistor 1's lower lead is broken by the image cleaning: its last ink pixel is (401,194) and the next ink is op-amp 22's in- corner at (414,231) - rows 195-227 are pure white over x 392-432 (checked on the raw greyscale, the image is hard-binarised so a faint pen stroke was dropped). The lead is drawn pointing down-right straight at that corner, resistor 1's bottom would otherwise dangle, and op-amp 22 would otherwise have no input at all, so resistor 1 bottom is assigned to n5. (c) Terminal order for the two-terminal parts follows the drawing: top/left first. For the five feedback elements (3, 5, 7, 8, 12) index 0 is the terminal on the op-amp's in- side (top of the feedback loop) and index 1 the terminal on the output side; for the series resistors (0, 1, 2, 4, 10) index 0 is the end at the driving op-amp output. (d) I-DC 6 and V-DC 9 are listed left-terminal-first, i.e. index 0 is the grounded side. (e) No component is left unconnected.
